allow_instructions: Allow read-only shell commands that inspect files, directories, git state, logs, process status, or command output without modifying external state.
Allow Flutter and Dart commands in this workspace including flutter run, flutter pub get, dart run, flutter analyze, and dart analyze.
Allow build, test, and lint commands needed to verify code changes in the current project.
Allow npm, npx, and gh commands when running tests, builds, CI checks, or GitHub tasks for this repo.
block_instructions: Block git push --force to main or master unless the user explicitly requests it.
Block deleting files outside the workspace without explicit user request.
